secrets.name: GROQ_API_KEY
secrets.description: Groq API key for AI captions/hashtags/hooks (console.groq.com/keys)

secrets.name: LIVEKIT_URL
secrets.description: LiveKit project WebSocket URL, e.g. wss://<project>.livekit.cloud (cloud.livekit.io > Settings)

secrets.name: RESEND_API_KEY
secrets.description: Resend API key for verification emails (resend.com/api-keys)

secrets.name: EMAIL_FROM
secrets.description: Sender address on a Resend-verified domain, e.g. Pulse <no-reply@yourdomain.com>

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
secrets.description: Telegram bot token for the admin/moderation bot (@BotFather)

secrets.name: TELEGRAM_ADMIN_CHAT_ID
secrets.description: Numeric Telegram chat id of the admin
